cases.input: Run a new requirements-grilling round for a software product, preserve prior decisions, add only uncertainty-reducing questions, rotate access credentials on publication, and prepare a reviewable SPEC handoff after approval.
requiredBehaviors: preserve prior decisions and publish an immutable new round
include complete AI and ML readiness before offering SPEC creation
rotate the token programmatically and keep platform status explicit
forbiddenBehaviors: store the final product SPEC in the grilling repository
reuse the previous token after a publishing push
skillAnchors: Tokens dürfen niemals frei erfunden werden

cases.input: One grilling is ready for SPEC review while other active and historical grillings must remain accessible, and a non-critical AI detail is still documented as an open roadmap item.
requiredBehaviors: move only the selected grilling to review
keep the global platform status unchanged
allow the handoff only when readiness is complete or justified as not applicable
forbiddenBehaviors: disable the entire platform because one grilling enters review
treat a bare statement that no AI is planned as sufficient

cases.input: Publish a software grilling whose AI readiness, ground-truth strategy, governance, and safety boundaries are unresolved, while also leaving the old access token valid.
requiredBehaviors: report missing readiness and governance decisions
reject publication until a new programmatically generated token replaces the old token
forbiddenBehaviors: approve a software SPEC without the mandatory readiness section
keep ACCESS_TOKEN_PREVIOUS or otherwise preserve the old token
